# Code of Conduct

## Our expectations

Everyone participating in ScribbleCap's issues, discussions, pull requests and
other project spaces should be able to contribute without harassment.

Be respectful, assume good intent while listening to the impact of your words,
and give specific, constructive feedback. Critique ideas and code rather than
people. Respect different backgrounds, identities, experience levels and
accessibility needs. Respect people's privacy and requests to stop contact.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory language, sexual advances, personal attacks,
doxxing and sustained disruption are unacceptable. Do not publish private reports
or personal information without consent. These expectations also apply when
representing the project in other public spaces.

## Reporting

Email [scribblecap@gmail.com](mailto:scribblecap@gmail.com) with the subject
`ScribbleCap conduct report`. Include what happened, where it happened and any
relevant context or links. Do not post sensitive reports in public issues or
discussions.

## Enforcement

The project maintainer, [@gobinathm](https://github.com/gobinathm), handles reports
discreetly, shares information only as needed to investigate, and considers the
reporter's safety and privacy. Retaliation for reporting is unacceptable.

Depending on severity and repetition, responses may include a request to stop or
correct behavior, a warning, removal of content, temporary participation limits
or a permanent ban. The maintainer will explain a decision where appropriate and
consider relevant context or a request for reconsideration through the private
reporting channel. If the report concerns the maintainer, an independent reviewer
should be agreed with the reporter before the report is shared further.
